title: You Never Know: Quantization Induces Inconsistent Biases in Vision-Language Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness disparities by measuring the difference in recall for zero-shot classification across perceived gender presentations (FACET dataset) and calculating representation skew (MaxSkew@k) in top-k image retrieval results across gender attributes (FairFace dataset).

Evaluating fairness disparities by measuring the difference in recall for zero-shot classification across lighter and darker skin tones (FACET dataset) and calculating representation skew (MaxSkew@k) in top-k image retrieval results across racial attributes (FairFace dataset).

Evaluating fairness disparities by measuring the difference in recall for zero-shot classification across binned age groups (younger, middle, older) on the FACET dataset, and calculating representation skew (MaxSkew@k) in top-k image retrieval results across age attributes on the FairFace dataset.
